title: Recent-Month Use Trend in Personal Services Plan Package Fitting
content:
A Personal Services Plan resident whose use in the last month departs clearly from the average monthly use has the required hours of a package fit adjusted in that direction.

## Rule

The required hours add 2.0 hours where the hours drawn and charged with a posting date within the last whole month before the request are at least 2.0 hours above the average monthly use, deduct 1.0 hour where they are at least 2.0 hours below it, and are unchanged otherwise. The adjustment is made before the required hours are rounded to two decimal places half up.

**Last whole month.** A posting falls within the last whole month before the request when less than one whole month has elapsed from its posting date to the request date, a whole month elapsing on the same day of the next month.

**Hours drawn and charged.** Every hours draw and every hourly charge on the plan's ledger posted in that month counts, whatever the reason the hours were owed. The comparison is made with the average monthly use as calculated, before any rounding.

## Ladder

| Hours drawn and charged in the last whole month, compared with the average monthly use | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| At least 2.0 hours above | Add 2.0 hours |
| At least 2.0 hours below | Deduct 1.0 hour |
| Otherwise | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical average monthly use of 6.0 hours)

| Hours in the last whole month | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 8.0 | Add 2.0 |
| 7.75 | None |
| 4.25 | None |
| 4.0 | Deduct 1.0 |

## Window boundary (hypothetical request on 15 September)

A posting dated 15 August is outside the last whole month; one dated 16 August is inside.
